R6:WE CAN ADAPT THE ACTIVITY WITHOUT ABA.example: We can adapt the activity without abandoning its purpose.
R6:WE CAN ADAPT THE ACTIVITY WITHOUT ABA.exampleZh: 可以調整活動而不放棄目的。

senses.meaning: 可以調整活動而不放棄目的

examples.en: We can adapt the activity without abandoning its purpose.
examples.zh: 可以調整活動而不放棄目的。

R6:UNFORESEEN.example: An unforeseen delay changed our plans.
R6:UNFORESEEN.exampleZh: 未料到的延誤改變我們的計畫。

senses.meaning: 事前沒有預料到的

examples.en: An unforeseen delay changed our plans.
examples.zh: 未料到的延誤改變我們的計畫。

R6:A DISTINCTIVE PIECE OF CLOTHING.meaning: 具有鮮明辨識特徵的衣物
R6:A DISTINCTIVE PIECE OF CLOTHING.example: A distinctive piece of clothing helped identify the character.
R6:A DISTINCTIVE PIECE OF CLOTHING.exampleZh: 有鮮明特徵的衣物幫助辨識角色。

senses.meaning: 具有鮮明辨識特徵的衣物

examples.en: A distinctive piece of clothing helped identify the character.
examples.zh: 有鮮明特徵的衣物幫助辨識角色。

R6:THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE.word: the costume should help the audience recognise the character
R6:THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE.meaning: 戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色
R6:THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE.example: The costume should help the audience recognise the character.
R6:THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE.exampleZh: 戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色。

senses.meaning: 戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色

examples.en: The costume should help the audience recognise the character.
examples.zh: 戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色。

R6:DISGUISE.meaning: 為隱藏身分而作的外表改裝
R6:DISGUISE.example: The hat was part of her disguise.
R6:DISGUISE.exampleZh: 帽子是她偽裝的一部分。

senses.meaning: 為隱藏身分而作的外表改裝

examples.en: The hat was part of her disguise.
examples.zh: 帽子是她偽裝的一部分。

R6:DISTINCTIVE.meaning: 特徵鮮明而容易辨認的
R6:DISTINCTIVE.example: The distinctive collar appears in every portrait.
R6:DISTINCTIVE.exampleZh: 每幅肖像都能看到那個特別的衣領。

senses.meaning: 特徵鮮明而容易辨認的

examples.en: The distinctive collar appears in every portrait.
examples.zh: 每幅肖像都能看到那個特別的衣領。

R6:UPHILL.example: The uphill section starts just beyond the cottages.
R6:UPHILL.exampleZh: 上坡路段從小屋再過去一點開始。

senses.meaning: 朝上坡方向的

examples.en: The uphill section starts just beyond the cottages.
examples.zh: 上坡路段從小屋再過去一點開始。

R6:LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTI.word: let us return to that familiar junction
R6:LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTI.meaning: 我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。
R6:LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTI.example: Let us return to that familiar junction.
R6:LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTI.exampleZh: 我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。。

senses.meaning: 我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。

examples.en: Let us return to that familiar junction.
examples.zh: 我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。。

R6:ORIENTATION.meaning: 對自身位置與方向的辨識
R6:ORIENTATION.example: The first exercise helps visitors develop a sense of orientation.
R6:ORIENTATION.exampleZh: 第一個練習幫助訪客建立位置與方向感。

senses.meaning: 對自身位置與方向的辨識

examples.en: The first exercise helps visitors develop a sense of orientation.
examples.zh: 第一個練習幫助訪客建立位置與方向感。

R6:VISIBILITY.example: Poor visibility made the distant tower hard to recognise.
R6:VISIBILITY.exampleZh: 能見度差，遠處的塔不容易辨認。

senses.meaning: 能見度；可看清的程度

examples.en: Poor visibility made the distant tower hard to recognise.
examples.zh: 能見度差，遠處的塔不容易辨認。

COMPLAINT.exampleZh: 我們收到了一起客戶投訴。

RESOLUTION.example: They reached a quick resolution to the problem.
RESOLUTION.exampleZh: 他們針對這個問題迅速達成了解決方案。

MUST HAVE.example: The laboratory was locked all night, but the window was open this morning. Someone must have left it open before locking up.
MUST HAVE.exampleZh: must have＋過去分詞表示根據線索推測過去。

TO HAVE BEEN DAMAGED.example: The bridge is thought to have been damaged during the storm last week.
TO HAVE BEEN DAMAGED.exampleZh: is thought to have been damaged 表示「被認為先前已受損」；橋是受損者，需完成式被動

ASSUME.example: The company agreed to assume responsibility for the error rather than blame the supplier.

HAVE BEEN TESTING.meaning: 從過去持續至今的測試
HAVE BEEN TESTING.example: The trial is still under way. Researchers have been testing the new coating for six months now.
HAVE BEEN TESTING.exampleZh: still under way 與 for six months now 表示從過去持續至今的測試，用現在完成進行式

HAD NOT LENT.meaning: 過去事件造成現在結果
HAD NOT LENT.example: The report refers to a single incident: you lent me your access card yesterday. I cannot find my own now. If you had not lent me your card yesterday, I would be unable to enter today.
HAD NOT LENT.exampleZh: 過去事件造成現在結果，混合條件句用 If＋過去完成式、would＋原形

REACH.example: The gallery hopes to reach a wider audience without changing its focus on local artists.
REACH.exampleZh: reach an audience 是觸及觀眾。

ARE BEING RENOVATED.example: Which form presents the renovation as ongoing now? The rooms are being renovated, so guests must use the west entrance.
ARE BEING RENOVATED.exampleZh: 題目指定描述現在正在施工。

BE CHANGED.example: The password should be changed by the administrator before anyone outside the team is given access.
BE CHANGED.exampleZh: by the administrator 指明執行更換者，password 是受動對象；should be changed 為情態助動詞後的被動

USERS MAY CHOOSE WHETHER TO INSTALL IT.word: users may choose whether to install it.
USERS MAY CHOOSE WHETHER TO INSTALL IT.example: 【句意】The update is optional rather than mandatory. Which statement is accurate?
USERS MAY CHOOSE WHETHER TO INSTALL IT.exampleZh: optional 是可選擇的，mandatory 是強制的；沒有安裝或移除的絕對要求

WHEN THE COMPUTER IS NOT POWERED ON.word: when the computer is not powered on.
WHEN THE COMPUTER IS NOT POWERED ON.meaning: 電腦關機才符合所述例外
WHEN THE COMPUTER IS NOT POWERED ON.example: 【條件】The backup runs automatically unless the computer is switched off. When would the stated exception apply?
WHEN THE COMPUTER IS NOT POWERED ON.exampleZh: unless 引入例外；電腦關機才符合所述例外，不代表其他狀況的備份一定成功

MITIGATE.example: Exercise helps mitigate heart disease risk.

WAS BEING CONVERTED.example: The conversion was only half finished when funding was withdrawn. Which form describes work in progress at that past moment? The warehouse was being converted into a community centre.
WAS BEING CONVERTED.exampleZh: 題目要呈現過去那一刻仍在進行的改建，用 was being converted

THE DURATION OF THE JOURNEY.meaning: 題目只以騎乘時間區分收費
THE DURATION OF THE JOURNEY.example: 【短文】A city offers free bike hire for journeys under thirty minutes. Longer journeys incur a fee, even when the bike is returned to the original station. What determines whether a fee applies?
THE DURATION OF THE JOURNEY.exampleZh: 題目只以騎乘時間區分收費，回原站也不能免除超時費

REFLECT.example: Students are encouraged to reflect on the feedback before submitting a revised draft.
REFLECT.exampleZh: be encouraged to 後接動詞原形 reflect。

HAS BEEN STUDYING.meaning: 定從去年春天延續到現在仍進行中的學習
HAS BEEN STUDYING.example: She began lessons last spring and still attends them. Which form links that start to an activity continuing now? She has been studying the language for almost a year.
HAS BEEN STUDYING.exampleZh: 指定從去年春天延續到現在仍進行中的學習，用現在完成進行式 has been studying；其餘把觀察點移到過去或未來

BUILD.example: Which verb combines with tension to mean increasing it? The director wanted the silence to build tension.
BUILD.exampleZh: build tension 是增加緊張感。

STATING THE RELATIONSHIP EXPLICITLY.example: 【語意】The novel leaves the reader to draw the connection. What does it avoid?
STATING THE RELATIONSHIP EXPLICITLY.exampleZh: leave...to draw the connection 是讓讀者自行建立關聯

EASE.meaning: 讓人放鬆自在的固定搭配
EASE.example: Her calm explanation helped put the nervous newcomer at ease.
EASE.exampleZh: put someone at ease 是讓人放鬆自在的固定搭配。

ALLOW.example: We will not allow taking photos here.
ALLOW.exampleZh: 我們將不允許在這裡拍照。

senses.meaning: 允許

examples.en: We will not allow taking photos here.
examples.zh: 我們將不允許在這裡拍照。

examples.en: You must not allow him to go alone.
examples.zh: 你絕不能允許他一個人去。

HAD BEEN WAITING.example: We had been waiting at the station for an hour when the cancellation was finally announced.
HAD BEEN WAITING.exampleZh: for an hour 表等待持續時間，when 引出已發生的過去宣布時點，需以過去完成進行式連接更早開始的等待；其餘以現在或未來為參照

IT IS NOT YET FULLY CONFIRMED.word: it is not yet fully confirmed.
IT IS NOT YET FULLY CONFIRMED.example: 【語意】The reservation is provisional until payment is received. What is its status?
IT IS NOT YET FULLY CONFIRMED.exampleZh: provisional 是暫定，until 設定轉為確定的條件

CANCELLATION MUST OCCUR BEFORE DEPARTURE.example: 【條件】Refunds are available only for tickets cancelled before departure. Which requirement is stated?
CANCELLATION MUST OCCUR BEFORE DEPARTURE.exampleZh: only for 與 before 限定退費條件，不能擴張為所有票皆可退

MUST HAVE BEEN RAINING.example: The cars emerging from the tunnel were covered in rain. Which form expresses a strong deduction about recent rain beyond the hill? It must have been raining there.
MUST HAVE BEEN RAINING.exampleZh: must have been raining 表對先前降雨作強烈肯定推測。

OBSERVE.example: Which verb means to comply with the terms of a truce? The two camps agreed to observe the truce.

HAS BEEN RESTORED.example: The gate will remain closed until the damaged seal has been restored by the maintenance team.
HAS BEEN RESTORED.exampleZh: seal 是維修團隊修復的對象，by 指明施事者；has been restored 是完成式被動

A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.word: a journey beyond the valley’s boundary.
A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.meaning: 越界行程不在明示承諾內
A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.example: 【語意】The guardian offers protection, but only within the valley. Which journey falls outside the stated promise?
A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.exampleZh: only within 限定地域，越界行程不在明示承諾內

THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.word: the condition attached to the welcome.
THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.meaning: 歡迎附帶繳存武器條件
THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.example: 【短文】A village gives travellers shelter on condition that they leave their weapons outside. One traveller insists that being welcomed means he may carry his sword inside. What has he overlooked?
THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.exampleZh: 歡迎附帶繳存武器條件，不能只採前半承諾

MUST HAVE LEFT.meaning: 暖水壺作過去剛離開的推測線索
MUST HAVE LEFT.example: The fire was out and the camp was empty, but the kettle was still warm. The travellers must have left recently.
MUST HAVE LEFT.exampleZh: 暖水壺作過去剛離開的推測線索，用 must have left。

CATER FOR.meaning: 滿足某群人的飲食或其他需求
CATER FOR.example: The café can cater for guests who do not eat dairy products. Which expression means to provide suitable food for them?
CATER FOR.exampleZh: cater for 表示滿足某群人的飲食或其他需求。

THAT.example: It was the lack of consultation that angered local residents.
THAT.exampleZh: It was X that... 是強調句。

HAD LIFTED.example: By the time we reached the clearing, the mist had lifted.
HAD LIFTED.exampleZh: reached 設定過去觀察時點，霧在抵達前已散去；過去完成式 had lifted 表此前已完成

SOME SECTIONS OF THE PATH ARE SLIPPERY.word: some sections of the path are slippery.
SOME SECTIONS OF THE PATH ARE SLIPPERY.example: 【語意】The path is slippery in places. What does in places tell walkers?
SOME SECTIONS OF THE PATH ARE SLIPPERY.exampleZh: in places 指某些地段，不是全線同樣情況

HAD CHARGED.meaning: 對已發生的過去表遺憾
HAD CHARGED.example: I wish I had charged the camera before leaving home; the battery is flat.
HAD CHARGED.exampleZh: 對已發生的過去表遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式

GIVE UP.example: Which expression means to stop playing fairly because the result seems impossible to change? The team must not give up before the final whistle.

RETURN.example: I want to return this shirt.

senses.meaning: 退回；歸還

examples.en: I want to return this shirt.
examples.zh: 我想退回這件襯衫。

examples.en: Please return the book next week.
examples.zh: 請下週歸還這本書。

PREARRANGED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「預先安排」。

WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.meaning: 現在或未來的混合條件句
WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.example: The session ended an hour ago. If I had known it was outdoors, I would have brought a warmer jacket with me yesterday.
WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.exampleZh: 活動與帶外套的時機均已過去，if had known 對應未實現的過去結果 would have brought；不是現在或未來的混合條件句

USE THE PENALTY COUNT TO BREAK THE TIE.word: use the penalty count to break the tie.
USE THE PENALTY COUNT TO BREAK THE TIE.example: 【短文】A competition ranks teams by points. If points are equal, fewer penalties decides the order. Two teams have equal points, but one has fewer penalties. Which rule applies?
USE THE PENALTY COUNT TO BREAK THE TIE.exampleZh: 題幹給同分排序規則；不是改寫得分

HAD BEEN RECORDED.example: The presenter said that the interview had been recorded the previous evening.
HAD BEEN RECORDED.exampleZh: said 與 the previous evening 建立過去轉述及更早完成的錄製；訪談是被錄製的對象，用 had been recorded

A CONCISE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT HAPPENED.word: a concise description of what happened.
A CONCISE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT HAPPENED.example: 【語意】The editor asks for a brief account of the meeting. What is requested?
A CONCISE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT HAPPENED.exampleZh: brief account 是簡短敘述，不是逐字稿或未來預測

AN INTERRUPTION IS POSSIBLE ON FRIDAY.word: an interruption is possible on friday.
AN INTERRUPTION IS POSSIBLE ON FRIDAY.example: 【範圍】A notice says the service may be interrupted on Friday. Which paraphrase preserves its certainty?
AN INTERRUPTION IS POSSIBLE ON FRIDAY.exampleZh: may 是可能，未說必然、整天或每週

WHETHER.example: The email was so badly worded that I could not tell whether the request was urgent.

PUT OFF.example: Which expression means to delay starting a task? We cannot put off cleaning the storeroom any longer.

ITS LOUDNESS RATHER THAN ITS PRESENCE.word: its loudness rather than its presence.
ITS LOUDNESS RATHER THAN ITS PRESENCE.example: 【語用】I do not mind the music, just not at a volume that fills every room. What is being challenged?
ITS LOUDNESS RATHER THAN ITS PRESENCE.exampleZh: 不反對音樂本身，只反對音量影響全部房間；未限定器材

TAKE CHARGE OF.example: Which expression means to take responsibility for a task? Could you take charge of checking the guest list?

WILL BE ABLE.meaning: 詢問即將到來的星期六實際能否出席
WILL BE ABLE.example: Today is Monday. Please let us know by this Thursday whether you will be able to attend this coming Saturday. We need your actual availability, not a hypothetical past situation.
WILL BE ABLE.exampleZh: 詢問即將到來的星期六實際能否出席，will be able to 表未來能力或可行性；其他形式描述過去或反事實情況

A CHOICE BETWEEN TWO PERIODS OF DUTY.word: a choice between two periods of duty.
A CHOICE BETWEEN TWO PERIODS OF DUTY.example: 【語意】Volunteers may choose a morning or afternoon shift, but not both. What is offered?
A CHOICE BETWEEN TWO PERIODS OF DUTY.exampleZh: or ... but not both 明示二擇一，不保證工作量相同

WHERE.example: A: where is the bank? B: It is next to the park.
WHERE.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「在哪裡」的實際運用。

A COPY MADE TO RESEMBLE THE ORIGINAL KEY.word: a copy made to resemble the original key.
A COPY MADE TO RESEMBLE THE ORIGINAL KEY.example: 【語意】The display contains a replica of the original key. What is on display?
A COPY MADE TO RESEMBLE THE ORIGINAL KEY.exampleZh: replica 是仿製複本，不是原件保證

THE AGE IMPLIED BY THE DESCRIPTION.word: the age implied by the description.
THE AGE IMPLIED BY THE DESCRIPTION.example: 【語意】The object is older than the label suggests. What is being questioned?
THE AGE IMPLIED BY THE DESCRIPTION.exampleZh: label suggests 指標籤傳達物件年代，不是標籤紙本年齡

WHOSE.example: A: whose bag is this on the classroom chair? B: It belongs to our teacher, Mr. Chen.
WHOSE.exampleZh: 詢問物品「是誰的」所有權，疑問詞使用 Whose。

ACROSS THE ROOM FROM HER.example: 【空間】Mara stood beside the door while Ben waited on the opposite side of the room. Where was Ben in relation to Mara?
ACROSS THE ROOM FROM HER.exampleZh: opposite side of room 指隔著房間對面，不是都在門邊

WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.word: where he had just put the letter.
WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.meaning: 行動先後顯示忘了自己放入口袋
WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.example: 【短文】Owen put the letter in his pocket, then searched the desk for it. His sister watched without speaking until he checked the pocket. What had he apparently forgotten?
WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.exampleZh: 行動先後顯示忘了自己放入口袋，未交代作者或來意

HAD VISITED.example: She spoke as though she had visited the place before, although she later admitted it was her first visit.
HAD VISITED.exampleZh: 她假裝先前曾來訪，實際卻是第一次；as though 後用過去完成式呈現比過去說話時更早、且與事實不符的經驗

IT QUIETLY UNDERCUTS HIS CLAIM.meaning: 遞回他未留在身邊的鑰匙形成不必明說的反證
IT QUIETLY UNDERCUTS HIS CLAIM.example: 【短文】At dinner, Leo announced that he never misplaced anything. His mother slid his keys across the table without comment. What effect does her action have?
IT QUIETLY UNDERCUTS HIS CLAIM.exampleZh: 遞回他未留在身邊的鑰匙形成不必明說的反證

IS TO BE.example: The label is to face outwards. Which form keeps this as an instruction, rather than speculation about an earlier event? The label is to be positioned with its printed side facing outwards.
IS TO BE.exampleZh: is to be positioned 是對擺放方式的要求，保留原指示。

TEN CENTIMETRES.example: 【尺寸】The card must be at least ten centimetres wide. Which width meets that requirement?
TEN CENTIMETRES.exampleZh: at least 包含等於下限，未說一定大於十

THE CARD IS FOLDED.example: 【順序】Fold the card before adding the ribbon. What should happen first?
THE CARD IS FOLDED.exampleZh: before 明確指定折卡在加緞帶前

TO BE CHANGED.example: The design allows the cover to be changed without removing the pages.
TO BE CHANGED.exampleZh: allow + 受詞 + to be changed，封面被換

CONSPICUOUS.example: The bird has a conspicuous white patch.

senses.meaning: 明顯而引人注意的

examples.en: The bird has a conspicuous white patch.
examples.zh: 鳥有醒目白斑。

THE PARK.example: 【路線】The library is between the station and the park. Starting at the station, you reach the library before the park. What comes next along that route?
THE PARK.exampleZh: 沿指定路線依序 station/library/park，圖內資訊已完整

ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.word: access is restricted for a stated period.
ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.meaning: 告示只限制樓上至中午
ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.example: 【範圍】A sign says the upper floor is closed until noon. What does it establish?
ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.exampleZh: 告示只限制樓上至中午，不擴及全部建物

CAN.example: Lisa is very musical. She can play the piano and guitar.
CAN.exampleZh: 助動詞 can 表能力，後接動詞原形且字尾不可變化。

THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.word: the route chosen affects the distance.
THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.meaning: 短路程依賴行人橋路線
THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.example: 【語用】It is only a short walk, provided you use the footbridge rather than follow the road all the way round. What qualifies the claim?
THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.exampleZh: 短路程依賴行人橋路線，未保證普遍可及性

IS.exampleZh: 介紹一個人用 This is...。

HAD PUT.example: I wish the audience had put their phones on silent before the show began.
HAD PUT.exampleZh: 對過去未做的事遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式

TO ALLOW THE REMAINING WORDS TO BE HEARD.word: to allow the remaining words to be heard.
TO ALLOW THE REMAINING WORDS TO BE HEARD.example: 【短文】The audience laughs before a character finishes a sentence. The actor waits, then delivers the last few words when the room is quiet. What is the likely reason?
TO ALLOW THE REMAINING WORDS TO BE HEARD.exampleZh: 等笑聲退以免蓋台詞，未給忘詞證據

A FOLDER.example: 【指涉】I can lend you the blue folder, but I need the red one back tonight. What does one refer to?
A FOLDER.exampleZh: one 代替前面的 folder，red one 為紅文件夾

TUESDAY AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON.word: tuesday at four in the afternoon.
TUESDAY AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON.example: 【短文】A message reads, I am free on Tuesday after three, or on Thursday before noon. Which proposed meeting fits?
TUESDAY AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON.exampleZh: after three / before noon 分別限定不同日，不能跨用時段

HAD NOT ENDED UP.meaning: 過去未回覆的反事實條件
HAD NOT ENDED UP.example: I would have replied sooner if your message had not ended up in the wrong folder.
HAD NOT ENDED UP.exampleZh: 過去未回覆的反事實條件，用 had not ended up

HAD DISAPPEARED.example: By the time we reached the ridge, the sun had disappeared behind the clouds.
HAD DISAPPEARED.exampleZh: 過去抵達前已不見，用過去完成式

THE RIVER.example: 【空間】The path ran along the river, with the hill to our left and the water to our right. What was immediately to the walkers’ right?
THE RIVER.exampleZh: water 與river同指，明示位於右側

WATER FALLING FROM WET LEAVES.meaning: 雨停後葉上餘水仍滴落
WATER FALLING FROM WET LEAVES.example: 【順序】The rain stopped before dawn, but the leaves were still dripping when the first light appeared. What persisted after the rain?
WATER FALLING FROM WET LEAVES.exampleZh: 雨停後葉上餘水仍滴落，與雨繼續不同

RESERVE.example: We will reserve a table for four at the restaurant.
RESERVE.exampleZh: 我們將會在餐廳預訂四人桌。

senses.meaning: 預訂

examples.en: We will reserve a table for four at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們將會在餐廳預訂四人桌。

examples.en: You have to reserve a seat in advance.
examples.zh: 你必須事先預訂座位。

ONE BOX AND TWO INDIVIDUAL CUPS.word: one box and two individual cups.
ONE BOX AND TWO INDIVIDUAL CUPS.example: 【數量】A box contains six cups. A customer needs eight cups and may buy individual cups as well as boxes. Which purchase supplies exactly eight?
ONE BOX AND TWO INDIVIDUAL CUPS.exampleZh: 六加二等八；題內提供單購選項

THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.word: the item must carry the relevant mark.
THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.meaning: 題內未設價格高低門檻
THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.example: 【範圍】A sign says the offer applies to marked items only. Which condition matters?
THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.exampleZh: only限markeditems，題內未設價格高低門檻

THE EXPLICIT CLOSING-TIME CONDITION.example: 【短文】A stall lends tools for a day and asks borrowers to return them before closing. A visitor assumes a day means the following morning. What should govern the return?
THE EXPLICIT CLOSING-TIME CONDITION.exampleZh: 題內明訂截止，不以抽象一天代替

REPAIR.example: The heater has been repaired by the landlord.
REPAIR.exampleZh: 暖氣已經被房東修理好了。

senses.meaning: 修理

examples.en: The heater has been repaired by the landlord.
examples.zh: 暖氣已經被房東修理好了。

senses.meaning: 維修

examples.en: If you need a repair, please inform us early.
examples.zh: 如果你需要維修，請提早通知我們。

SHE MAY TAKE ONE MORE ITEM.word: she may take one more item.
SHE MAY TAKE ONE MORE ITEM.example: 【短文】An exchange table lets visitors take one item for each item they leave. Jo leaves three objects, takes two, and asks whether she has used the whole allowance. What follows from the rule?
SHE MAY TAKE ONE MORE ITEM.exampleZh: 三換三上限，已取二還可一，未說必須取滿

HAS BEEN.example: We should focus on the usage of has been in modern English.
HAS BEEN.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「被提高」的核心用法。

ON THE TABLE.example: We should focus on the usage of on the table in modern English.
ON THE TABLE.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「此題測試指令理解」的核心用法。

THE PARCEL ARRIVED BEFORE THREE.example: 【短文】A message says, The parcel arrived after lunch but before Eva left. Eva left at three. What is established?
THE PARCEL ARRIVED BEFORE THREE.exampleZh: afterlunch/beforeleft限定抵達三點前，未定精時

WOULD NOT BE.example: Had the civil engineers reinforced the levee system, the coastal basin would not be submerged today.
WOULD NOT BE.exampleZh: 過去完成式假設對應現在結果（錯綜條件句），主要子句使用 would not be。

RECEIVES.example: Each player receives two cards at the beginning of a round.

MAY CHOOSE TO MAKE OR OMIT.word: may choose to make or omit
MAY CHOOSE TO MAKE OR OMIT.example: A move described as optional is one a player may choose to make or omit.
MAY CHOOSE TO MAKE OR OMIT.exampleZh: optional可選，不指定勝負或必先做

REVEALING THE CARD.example: 【順序】Draw a card, reveal it, and then move your piece. Which action immediately precedes moving?

HAS FINISHED.example: She is very excited because she has finished her final assignment for the coding class.
HAS FINISHED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式。

TWO RED TOKENS AND NO BLUE TOKENS LEFT.word: two red tokens and no blue tokens left.
TWO RED TOKENS AND NO BLUE TOKENS LEFT.example: 【規則】A player may exchange two blue tokens for one red token. Jo has four blue tokens and no red tokens. She makes this exchange twice. What does she have from those exchanges?
TWO RED TOKENS AND NO BLUE TOKENS LEFT.exampleZh: 每次消二藍換一紅，兩次耗四藍得二紅

WAS LIVING.example: The interviewer asked me where I was living when the old theatre closed.
WAS LIVING.exampleZh: 間接問句用陳述語序，過去時背景為was living

WRITE DOWN WHAT WAS SAID.example: To transcribe an interview is to write down what was said.
WRITE DOWN WHAT WAS SAID.exampleZh: transcribe將口語轉成書面，不必作真假判決

THE UNCLE.example: 【指涉】I showed the photograph to my uncle, and he recognised the woman beside the gate. Who recognised the woman?

AN ASSUMPTION BUILT INTO THE QUESTION.word: an assumption built into the question.
AN ASSUMPTION BUILT INTO THE QUESTION.example: 【短文】An interviewer asks how difficult the move was. The speaker says she had found it exciting rather than difficult. What did the speaker correct?
AN ASSUMPTION BUILT INTO THE QUESTION.exampleZh: how difficult預設困難，回答拒絕此框架

KNOCKING ON.example: I remember knocking on the door, but I cannot remember who opened it.
KNOCKING ON.exampleZh: remember doing回想已做事件，不是記得要做。

WOULD NOT.example: We closed the window so that the music would not disturb the neighbours.
WOULD NOT.exampleZh: 過去情境的目的子句用so that…would not，表示避免打擾。

GRADUALLY BECOMES QUIETER.example: If a sound fades away, it gradually becomes quieter.
GRADUALLY BECOMES QUIETER.exampleZh: fade away指逐漸消弱，不必涉及聲源移動。

THE BELL.example: 【指涉】The bell rang after the choir finished, and its sound filled the hall. What does its refer to?
THE BELL.exampleZh: 主句the bell rang後的its sound承接鈴聲；並未提指揮

HAD WE OPENED.example: Hardly had we opened the door when the alarm began to ring.
HAD WE OPENED.exampleZh: Hardly置句首需倒裝；先開門後響鈴，用had we opened

WOULD NOT BE STANDING.meaning: 過去未查時間造成現在困境
WOULD NOT BE STANDING.example: If we had checked the opening hours, we would not be standing outside a locked door now.
WOULD NOT BE STANDING.exampleZh: 過去未查時間造成現在困境，混合條件句用would not be standing。

TO ALLOW FOR A POSSIBLE DELAY.word: to allow for a possible delay.
TO ALLOW FOR A POSSIBLE DELAY.example: 【語意】We have kept the afternoon free in case the morning session runs over. What is the purpose?
TO ALLOW FOR A POSSIBLE DELAY.exampleZh: in case為預先防備可能狀況；不保證會延誤或一定提早結束

WHICH.example: The report, which was due today, is delayed.
WHICH.exampleZh: 逗號後的補充說明（非限定子句）只能用 which，不能用 that。

THE SLEEVES ARE TOO LONG.example: 【語意】The jacket fits across the shoulders, but the sleeves need shortening. What is the problem?
THE SLEEVES ARE TOO LONG.exampleZh: need shortening表示袖長過長，肩部尺寸合適已明說

HAD TRIED.meaning: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾
HAD TRIED.example: I wish I had tried the coat on before buying it; it is much heavier than I expected.
HAD TRIED.exampleZh: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾，用wish加過去完成式had tried

WORN WITH EITHER SIDE FACING OUT.word: worn with either side facing out
WORN WITH EITHER SIDE FACING OUT.example: A reversible jacket can be worn with either side facing out.
WORN WITH EITHER SIDE FACING OUT.exampleZh: reversible指正反兩面皆可穿，不涉及退貨權或洗法

BREAKING IN.example: The boots need breaking in before they are comfortable enough for a long walk.

THE SHORTER ROUTE IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.word: the shorter route is no longer available.
THE SHORTER ROUTE IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.example: 【路線】The riverside path is shorter, but it closes at dusk. It is already dark, so we will take the road through the village. Why was that route chosen?
THE SHORTER ROUTE IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.exampleZh: 路徑黃昏關閉，現在已黑；選村內道路是可用性，不是距離改變

RECOGNISING WHERE THEY ARE.example: 【字彙】The guide suggests using the clock tower as a landmark when walking back. What should visitors use it for?
RECOGNISING WHERE THEY ARE.exampleZh: landmark在找路語境是可辨識位置的地標，未要求讀時間或進入塔內

HAD CHECKED.example: By the time we reached the junction, the guide had checked the route twice already.
HAD CHECKED.exampleZh: reached為過去參照點，already與twice表示此前已完成兩次，用過去完成式

THE FOOTBRIDGE.meaning: 否接近自行增加通行條件
THE FOOTBRIDGE.example: 【指涉】The footbridge runs beside the railway bridge, but only the former is open to walkers. Which bridge may walkers use?
THE FOOTBRIDGE.exampleZh: former指前述第一者footbridge，不能由火車是否接近自行增加通行條件

WHAT THE LINE STYLES MEAN.meaning: 題內說明線型對應坡度
WHAT THE LINE STYLES MEAN.example: 【短文】A map uses a dotted line for a steep path and a solid line for a flatter one. The key explains this distinction. What should a visitor check before choosing?
WHAT THE LINE STYLES MEAN.exampleZh: 題內說明線型對應坡度，應讀圖例；沒有提供更新時間或終點差別

HAS BEEN DISCUSSING.example: The committee has been discussing the proposed tax reforms for three hours without reaching a consensus.
HAS BEEN DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 句中有「for three hours」強調動作持續進行且尚未結束，符合現在完成進行式的使用時機

IS EXPECTED TO BE REVIEWED.example: The controversial policy is expected to be reviewed by the board of directors during next month's meeting.
IS EXPECTED TO BE REVIEWED.exampleZh: 政策是「被預期將被審查」，需使用「is expected to be + V-p.p.」的複雜被動語態

MUST HAVE MISSED.example: The CEO's flight was delayed by a severe storm, so she must have missed the opening speech.
MUST HAVE MISSED.exampleZh: 基於班機延誤的事實，對過去發生的事情作肯定推測，應使用「must have + V-p.p.」，表示「一定已經錯過了」。

ALLEVIATE.example: The new road will alleviate traffic.

HAVE BEEN INVESTIGATING.example: Scientists have been investigating this rare phenomenon since 2015, yet its true origin remains a mystery.
HAVE BEEN INVESTIGATING.exampleZh: 「since 2015」加上現在式「remains」，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式

IS BELIEVED.example: The latest software update is believed to have caused several system crashes across the network.
IS BELIEVED.exampleZh: 「被認為」造成了當機，主詞是軟體更新，應使用被動語態 is believed (to have + V-p.p.)。

MUST HAVE USED.example: There was no forced entry, meaning the thief must have used a key to open the safe.
MUST HAVE USED.exampleZh: 沒有強行破壞的痕跡，代表小偷過去「一定使用了」鑰匙，這是有強烈依據的過去推測。

IT HAS BEEN LOSING MONEY RECENTLY.word: it has been losing money recently.
IT HAS BEEN LOSING MONEY RECENTLY.example: 【短文】Memo: The upcoming quarterly report is currently being drafted by the finance team. It is expected to be finalized by Friday. Since we have been experiencing a substantial deficit, all department heads must have prepared their cost-cutting strategies prior to the meeting. Q: What is implied about the company's financial status?
IT HAS BEEN LOSING MONEY RECENTLY.exampleZh: 短文中提到「experiencing a substantial deficit」（經歷大幅虧損），因此暗示公司最近在賠錢

HAVE BEEN INVESTING.example: Our competitors have been investing aggressively in artificial intelligence for the past few years to gain market share.
HAVE BEEN INVESTING.exampleZh: for the past few years 表示動作的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式

TO BE ANNOUNCED.example: The new regulations are rumored to be announced next week, although official confirmation is still pending.
TO BE ANNOUNCED.exampleZh: be rumored to be + V-p.p. 表示「據傳將被...」，法規是被公布的對象

MUST HAVE OVERLOOKED.example: You submitted the report without the financial attachments; you must have overlooked them in your hurry.
MUST HAVE OVERLOOKED.exampleZh: 對於過去發生的失誤進行高度肯定的推測，「你當時一定是忽略了」，用 must have + V-p.p.。

UNEXPECTED.example: The CEO's sudden resignation was completely unexpected; no one in the company saw it coming.

HAD BEEN ADVOCATING.example: The environmental group had been advocating for stricter carbon emission laws long before the recent climate summit.
HAD BEEN ADVOCATING.exampleZh: 在「過去的」氣候高峰會之前，就一直持續在倡議，屬於過去完成進行式的使用情境（比過去更早並持續）

IS THOUGHT.example: The ancient manuscript is thought to have been written by a renowned scholar in the 12th century.
IS THOUGHT.exampleZh: 手稿「被認為」寫於12世紀，需用被動語態 is thought (to have been written)。

MUST HAVE BEEN.example: The sales figures are incredibly low this quarter. The marketing campaign must have been a total failure.
MUST HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 基於銷售額極低的強烈證據，推測過去的行銷活動「一定是」徹底失敗了。

ALLOCATE.example: Allocate additional resources to the project.

INTRODUCING FLEXIBLE WORKING SCHEDULES.example: 【短文】Case Study: TechNova Inc. has been struggling with employee retention for two years. Industry analysts speculate that the rigid corporate culture must have driven top talent away. To combat this, flexible working hours are expected to be implemented next quarter. Q: What is the proposed solution to TechNova's problem?
INTRODUCING FLEXIBLE WORKING SCHEDULES.exampleZh: 文章最後提到「flexible working hours are expected to be implemented」（預計實施彈性工時）以解決問題

A GROUP OF MEDICAL EXPERTS.meaning: 公認由醫學專家聯盟起草
A GROUP OF MEDICAL EXPERTS.example: 【短文】Policy Brief: The new healthcare reform aims to alleviate the burden on public hospitals. It is widely acknowledged to have been drafted by a coalition of medical experts. However, critics argue that the policy is fundamentally flawed. Q: Who is believed to be the author of the reform?
A GROUP OF MEDICAL EXPERTS.exampleZh: 文中指出「It is widely acknowledged to have been drafted by a coalition of medical experts」（公認由醫學專家聯盟起草）

TO HAVE BEEN STOLEN.example: The confidential documents are reported to have been stolen from the executive's office last night.
TO HAVE BEEN STOLEN.exampleZh: 報導現在發生（are reported），但失竊發生在昨晚，需用 to have been stolen 表達過去完成的被動概念

RELUCTANCE.example: The manager's reluctance to compromise led to the collapse of the trade negotiations.

HAS BEEN RISING.example: Inflation has been rising steadily over the past six months, causing widespread concern among consumers.
HAS BEEN RISING.exampleZh: over the past six months 表達這半年來不斷進行的趨勢，選現在完成進行式

ARE PRESUMED.example: The rare artifacts are presumed to have been buried during a massive volcanic eruption.
ARE PRESUMED.exampleZh: 文物「被推定」掩埋於火山爆發，文物是受詞，需用被動語態 are presumed。

MUST HAVE RAINED.example: The streets are completely flooded this morning. It must have rained heavily last night.
MUST HAVE RAINED.exampleZh: 看到早上淹水的結果，推測昨晚「一定」下了大雨，用 must have + V-p.p.。

DISRUPTED.example: The startup's innovative approach has severely disrupted the traditional banking industry.

CRITICAL AND CONDEMNATORY.example: 【短文】Editorial: The mayor's decision to cut public transit funding is fundamentally flawed. Citizens have been complaining about service delays for months. This disastrous policy is guaranteed to be met with fierce protests. The administration must have severely underestimated the public's reliance on buses and trains. Q: What is the author's attitude toward the mayor's decision?
CRITICAL AND CONDEMNATORY.exampleZh: 作者使用了 fundamentally flawed (根本上有缺陷), disastrous policy (災難性政策) 等詞彙，顯示其態度為強烈批評(Critical)

HAS BEEN EXAMINING.example: The legal team has been examining the contract details meticulously since the dispute arose.
HAS BEEN EXAMINING.exampleZh: 「since」引導的時間起點搭配「has been examining」，強調動作一直持續

TO HAVE BEEN.example: The new marketing strategy is considered to have been extremely successful in boosting sales.
TO HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 被認為（現在）在提升銷量上非常成功（過去的成果），用 to have been

MUST HAVE GOTTEN.example: You left your umbrella at the office; you must have gotten drenched in that sudden downpour.
MUST HAVE GOTTEN.exampleZh: 對過去已經發生的事情作推測，「你當時一定淋濕了」，用 must have gotten。

HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING.meaning: 描述近期不斷進行並持續中的變化趨勢
HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING.example: Global temperatures have been fluctuating at an alarming rate, prompting immediate calls for climate action.
HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING.exampleZh: 描述近期不斷進行並持續中的變化趨勢，使用現在完成進行式最恰當

TO BE HELD.example: The summit is scheduled to be held in Geneva, though the exact venue is yet to be confirmed.
TO BE HELD.exampleZh: 高峰會是「被舉辦」，因此在 scheduled 後方接不定詞的被動形式 to be held

MUST HAVE PREPARED.example: The presentation slides are full of errors. He must have prepared them at the very last minute.
MUST HAVE PREPARED.exampleZh: 簡報充滿錯誤，強烈推測他過去「一定是在最後一刻才準備的」，用 must have + V-p.p.。

CONCESSIONS.example: In order to finalize the deal, both parties must be willing to make concessions.

ILL MAKE SURE TO ATTEND IT THEN.word: i'll make sure to attend it then.
ILL MAKE SURE TO ATTEND IT THEN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
ILL MAKE SURE TO ATTEND IT THEN.exampleZh: The safety briefing has been made mandatory for all site visitors. (所有現場參觀者的安全簡報已改為強制性

GOOD THAT KEEPS US OUT OF LEGAL TROUBLE.word: good, that keeps us out of legal trouble.
GOOD THAT KEEPS US OUT OF LEGAL TROUBLE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
GOOD THAT KEEPS US OUT OF LEGAL TROUBLE.exampleZh: We have been complying with all the new industry regulations. (我們一直遵守著所有新的行業法規

PROGRESS.example: We have made significant progress on the new app.
PROGRESS.exampleZh: 我們在新的應用程式上已經取得了顯著的進步。

senses.meaning: 進步

examples.en: We have made significant progress on the new app.
examples.zh: 我們在新的應用程式上已經取得了顯著的進步。

examples.en: If we work together, we will see progress soon.
examples.zh: 如果我們合作，我們很快就會看到進步。

DEADLINE.example: We must submit the proposal before the deadline.

WE HAVE BEEN WORKING ON THIS.word: we have been working on this
WE HAVE BEEN WORKING ON THIS.example: We have been working on this.

EVALUATE.example: We need to evaluate the results.

OPTIMIZE.example: We optimized the website for mobile.
OPTIMIZE.exampleZh: 我們針對手機優化了網站。

INTEGRATE.example: We need to integrate the new software with our existing system.
INTEGRATE.exampleZh: 我們需要將新軟體與現有系統整合。

senses.meaning: 整合、併入

examples.en: The company plans to integrate its global operations.
examples.zh: 公司計畫整合其全球業務。

examples.en: He easily integrated into the new community.
examples.zh: 他很容易地融入了新社區。

UNACCEPTABLE.example: They declared that the sudden delay had been completely unacceptable.
UNACCEPTABLE.exampleZh: 他們宣稱那次突然的延誤是完全無法接受的。

senses.meaning: 不能接受的

examples.en: They declared that the sudden delay had been completely unacceptable.
examples.zh: 他們宣稱那次突然的延誤是完全無法接受的。

examples.en: If the overall quality were this poor, it would be unacceptable to our clients.
examples.zh: 如果整體品質這麼差，對我們的客戶來說將是無法接受的。

INCONVENIENCE.example: They apologized for the inconvenience they had caused.
INCONVENIENCE.exampleZh: 他們為所造成的不便道歉。

senses.meaning: 不便；麻煩

examples.en: They apologized for the inconvenience they had caused.
examples.zh: 他們為所造成的不便道歉。

examples.en: If we had informed them earlier, it wouldn't have caused such a huge inconvenience.
examples.zh: 如果我們早點通知他們，就不會造成這麼大的不便了。

INVESTIGATE.example: The police are investigating the cause of the fire.
INVESTIGATE.exampleZh: 警方正在調查起火的原因。

senses.meaning: 調查

examples.en: The police are investigating the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查起火的原因。

examples.en: We will investigate this issue immediately.
examples.zh: 我們將立即調查這個問題。

DEFECTIVE.example: The customer returned the product because it was defective.
DEFECTIVE.exampleZh: 顧客退還了該產品，因為它有瑕疵。

senses.meaning: 有缺陷的；有毛病的

examples.en: The customer returned the product because it was defective.
examples.zh: 顧客退還了該產品，因為它有瑕疵。

examples.en: We will replace any defective parts free of charge.
examples.zh: 我們將免費更換任何有缺陷的零件。

senses.meaning: 生產力

examples.en: Employee productivity has increased recently.
examples.zh: 員工的生產力最近提高了。

examples.en: We aim to maximize our productivity.
examples.zh: 我們的目標是使生產力最大化。

HAVE YOU NOTICED ANY UNUSUAL SPIKES.word: have you noticed any unusual spikes?
HAVE YOU NOTICED ANY UNUSUAL SPIKES.meaning: 你有注意到任何異常的流量高峰嗎？
HAVE YOU NOTICED ANY UNUSUAL SPIKES.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
HAVE YOU NOTICED ANY UNUSUAL SPIKES.exampleZh: 原句：We have been monitoring the server traffic since the product launch.（自從產品發表後，我們一直在監控伺服器流量

I HOPE THEY REACH A CONSENSUS SOON.word: i hope they reach a consensus soon.
I HOPE THEY REACH A CONSENSUS SOON.meaning: 我希望他們很快達成共識
I HOPE THEY REACH A CONSENSUS SOON.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I HOPE THEY REACH A CONSENSUS SOON.exampleZh: 原句：The new zoning regulations are currently being debated at the city hall.（新的分區法規目前正在市政廳進行辯論

THEY MUST BE EXHAUSTED BY NOW.word: they must be exhausted by now.
THEY MUST BE EXHAUSTED BY NOW.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
THEY MUST BE EXHAUSTED BY NOW.exampleZh: 原句：Our developers have been resolving the software glitches overnight.（我們的開發人員熬夜一直在解決軟體故障

WILL THE CITY COUNCIL ADDRESS THIS ISSUE.word: will the city council address this issue?
WILL THE CITY COUNCIL ADDRESS THIS ISSUE.meaning: 市議會會處理這個問題嗎？
WILL THE CITY COUNCIL ADDRESS THIS ISSUE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
WILL THE CITY COUNCIL ADDRESS THIS ISSUE.exampleZh: 原句：The residents have been voicing their concerns about the noise pollution.（居民們一直在表達他們對噪音汙染的擔憂

HAVE YOU COMPILED THE RESULTS YET.word: have you compiled the results yet?
HAVE YOU COMPILED THE RESULTS YET.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
HAVE YOU COMPILED THE RESULTS YET.exampleZh: 原句：We have been gathering feedback on the new prototype for a month.（我們收集新原型機的回饋已經一個月了

HAVE THEY ANSWERED ANY OF YOUR CALLS.word: have they answered any of your calls?
HAVE THEY ANSWERED ANY OF YOUR CALLS.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
HAVE THEY ANSWERED ANY OF YOUR CALLS.exampleZh: 原句：We have been trying to contact the supplier regarding the delayed shipment.（我們一直試圖聯繫供應商詢問延遲出貨的事

DID THEY FIND ANY WEAK POINTS.word: did they find any weak points?
DID THEY FIND ANY WEAK POINTS.meaning: 他們有發現任何弱點嗎？
DID THEY FIND ANY WEAK POINTS.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
DID THEY FIND ANY WEAK POINTS.exampleZh: 原句：They have been analyzing the competitor's market strategy all week.（他們整個星期都在分析競爭對手的市場策略

HAVE THEY FOUND ANY OVERHEATING ISSUES.word: have they found any overheating issues?
HAVE THEY FOUND ANY OVERHEATING ISSUES.meaning: 他們有發現任何過熱問題嗎？
HAVE THEY FOUND ANY OVERHEATING ISSUES.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
HAVE THEY FOUND ANY OVERHEATING ISSUES.exampleZh: 原句：The engineering team has been conducting rigorous tests on the new battery.（工程團隊一直在對新電池進行嚴格測試

HAS BEEN REVIEWING.example: The legal counsel has been reviewing the proposed non-disclosure agreement for the past three weeks.
HAS BEEN REVIEWING.exampleZh: 句尾有 for the past three weeks（過去三週以來），表示動作從過去持續到現在且可能還在進行，應使用現在完成進行式 (has been reviewing)

TO BE APPROVED.example: The amended privacy clause is expected to be approved by the regulatory committee next Monday.
TO BE APPROVED.exampleZh: be expected to 後面接原形動詞

MUST NOT HAVE READ.example: The tenant breached the contract so easily; he must not have read the penalty terms carefully.
MUST NOT HAVE READ.exampleZh: 前半句指出租客輕易違約（發生在過去），推測他當時「一定沒有」仔細閱讀罰則，表對過去否定的強烈推測用 must not have V-en。

STIPULATES.example: The new contract explicitly stipulates that all intellectual property rights belong to the employer.
STIPULATES.exampleZh: stipulate 意為「規定、明確要求」，符合合約規定權利的語境。

TO HAVE BEEN RETURNED.example: The intellectual property rights are widely assumed to have been returned to the original creator, despite the recent lawsuit.
TO HAVE BEEN RETURNED.exampleZh: 被廣泛認為 (are widely assumed) 的事情發生在過去，且權利是被歸還的，故使用 to have been + V-en 表達發生在過去的被動語態

HAS BEEN GATHERING.meaning: 從過去持續到現在的動作
HAS BEEN GATHERING.example: The HR department has been gathering employee feedback regarding the new remote work policy since its implementation.
HAS BEEN GATHERING.exampleZh: 有 since 加上過去的時間點 (its implementation)，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，選現在完成進行式

TO BE CLAIMED.example: All unused vacation days are required to be claimed before the end of the fiscal year.
TO BE CLAIMED.exampleZh: require sth to be V-en，特休假 (vacation days) 是「被申請、被使用」的，所以必須用被動不定詞 to be claimed

ACCRUE.example: Employees can accrue up to 15 days of paid time off per year, which will roll over to the next year if unused.
ACCRUE.exampleZh: accrue 意為「累積」，常與休假或利息搭配。

TO BE TRANSITIONED.example: The annual performance review process is scheduled to be transitioned entirely to a digital platform by next quarter.
TO BE TRANSITIONED.exampleZh: is scheduled 後接 to V，而審查流程是被轉移到數位平台，故選被動不定詞 to be transitioned

TO HAVE BEEN CORRUPTED.example: The experimental data is believed to have been corrupted by a sudden fluctuation in the laboratory's temperature yesterday.
TO HAVE BEEN CORRUPTED.exampleZh: is believed (現在被認為)，但破壞數據發生在昨天(yesterday)，須用 to have V-en 表過去，且數據是被破壞，故選 to have been corrupted

VALIDATE.example: We need to validate the data before reporting it.
VALIDATE.exampleZh: 在報告之前，我們需要驗證這些數據。

senses.meaning: 驗證

examples.en: We need to validate the data before reporting it.
examples.zh: 在報告之前，我們需要驗證這些數據。

examples.en: Her findings validate our previous assumptions.
examples.zh: 她的發現證實了我們之前的假設。

TO BE RESTORED.example: The historic castle, which was heavily damaged by fire, is expected to be restored to its former glory by 2028.
TO BE RESTORED.exampleZh: is expected 後接 to V，城堡是「被修復」，故使用被動不定詞 to be restored

MUST HAVE SOLD.example: The flight was completely overbooked by noon. The airline must have sold more tickets than there were available seats.
MUST HAVE SOLD.exampleZh: 班機超賣是過去發生的事實，推論航空公司當時「一定賣了」超過座位的票，用 must have V-en。

RESURGENCE.meaning: 衰退後重新增強或活躍

senses.meaning: 衰退後重新增強或活躍

examples.en: The club enjoyed a resurgence.
examples.zh: 俱樂部重新振作。

HAVE BEEN PRAISING.meaning: 延續至今的動作應選現在完成進行式
HAVE BEEN PRAISING.example: Literary critics have been praising the author's unconventional narrative style since her debut novel was published.
HAVE BEEN PRAISING.exampleZh: since her debut novel was published 標示了過去的起點，延續至今的動作應選現在完成進行式

TO BE WRITTEN.example: The highly anticipated sequel is rumored to be written from the perspective of the original villain.
TO BE WRITTEN.exampleZh: is rumored (被謠傳) 後接 to V，續集是「被寫成」，所以用 to be written

MUST HAVE DELETED.example: The protagonist's sudden change of heart felt completely unearned. The editor must have deleted a crucial transitional chapter before publication.
MUST HAVE DELETED.exampleZh: 讀者感覺主角心境轉變太突兀，推測編輯在出版前「一定刪掉了」過渡章節。

CAPTIVATING.example: The novelist's ability to create a truly captivating atmosphere keeps readers on the edge of their seats.
CAPTIVATING.exampleZh: captivating 意為「迷人的、具吸引力的」，修飾氣氛最為恰當。

EVOKE.example: Despite its flaws, the book successfully manages to evoke a deep sense of nostalgia for a bygone era.
EVOKE.exampleZh: evoke 意為「喚起(記憶、情感)」，常與 nostalgia (鄉愁/懷舊感) 搭配。

TO HAVE ALTERED.example:
A: Have you reviewed the drafted policy?
B: Yes, but the new wording is confusing. The HR manager is believed to have altered it without consulting the legal team.
Q: What belongs in the blank?
TO HAVE ALTERED.exampleZh: is believed (現在被認為)，而更改措辭是過去發生的事，且為人資經理主動更改，故用 to have altered

HAS BEEN OVERHAULING.example:
A: Why is the server down again?
B: The IT department has been overhauling the system infrastructure all morning. It should be back online soon.
Q: What belongs in the blank?
HAS BEEN OVERHAULING.exampleZh: all morning 強調從早上一直持續到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式 has been overhauling (全面檢修)

IT IS CURRENTLY BEING REPAIRED.example: 【短文】Notice: The pool area has been undergoing maintenance. It is scheduled to be reopened next Monday. Q: What is the current status of the pool area?
IT IS CURRENTLY BEING REPAIRED.exampleZh: has been undergoing maintenance 表示一直在進行維修，對應 currently being repaired

EXEMPTION.example: Memo: The upcoming workshop is mandatory for all new hires. Anyone who misses it must submit a valid exemption request. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
EXEMPTION.exampleZh: mandatory (強制的)，如果缺席必須提交有效的「豁免 (exemption)」申請才合理。

HAVE BEEN EVALUATING.meaning: 分析師們持續進行評估的動作
HAVE BEEN EVALUATING.example: The financial analysts have been evaluating the market trends rigorously to predict the next economic shift.
HAVE BEEN EVALUATING.exampleZh: 分析師們持續進行評估的動作，以預測未來的變動，用現在完成進行式最符合語境與文法

TO HAVE BEEN REPEALED.example: The controversial employment regulations are confirmed to have been repealed by the parliament during yesterday's session.
TO HAVE BEEN REPEALED.exampleZh: are confirmed 是現在式，但廢除 (repeal) 發生在 yesterday，且法規是被廢除的，需用完成式被動不定詞 to have been repealed

TO HAVE SHED.example: The documentary is widely considered to have shed light on the overlooked contributions of female scientists. The director must have done extensive archival research.
TO HAVE SHED.exampleZh: is widely considered (被廣泛認為)，而紀錄片揭露真相 (shed light on) 是過去已發生的成就，故用 to have shed

DECLINE.example: He told me he had declined the job offer.
DECLINE.exampleZh: 他告訴我他已經婉拒了那個工作機會。

senses.meaning: 下降；婉拒

examples.en: He told me he had declined the job offer.
examples.zh: 他告訴我他已經婉拒了那個工作機會。

senses.meaning: 下降；衰退

examples.en: If the decline continued, we would face bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 如果這種下降趨勢持續，我們將面臨破產。

SUMMARIZE.example: She summarized what they had extensively discussed in the morning meeting.
SUMMARIZE.exampleZh: 她總結了他們在早會上廣泛討論的內容。

senses.meaning: 總結；概述

examples.en: She summarized what they had extensively discussed in the morning meeting.
examples.zh: 她總結了他們在早會上廣泛討論的內容。

examples.en: If you could summarize the whole article in one paragraph, it would be great.
examples.zh: 如果你能將整篇文章總結成一個段落，那就太好了。

DRASTICALLY.example: The company's profits dropped drastically last quarter.
DRASTICALLY.exampleZh: 公司利潤上個季度大幅下降。

senses.meaning: 大幅地

examples.en: The company's profits dropped drastically last quarter.
examples.zh: 公司利潤上個季度大幅下降。

examples.en: Our lifestyle has changed drastically since moving here.
examples.zh: 自從搬到這裡後，我們的生活方式發生了大幅改變。

IT MUST HAVE BEEN A MISTAKE.word: it must have been a mistake
IT MUST HAVE BEEN A MISTAKE.example: It must have been a mistake.

LET US KICK OFF THE MEETING.word: let us kick off the meeting
LET US KICK OFF THE MEETING.example: Let us kick off the meeting.

FURTHERMORE.example: She mentioned that the budget was low and, furthermore, time had run out.
FURTHERMORE.exampleZh: 她提到預算很低，此外，時間已經用完了。

senses.meaning: 此外

examples.en: She mentioned that the budget was low and, furthermore, time had run out.
examples.zh: 她提到預算很低，此外，時間已經用完了。

examples.en: If it had rained, we would have stayed indoors; furthermore, the event would have been ruined.
examples.zh: 如果下雨了，我們就會待在室內；此外，活動也會被搞砸。

PERSPECTIVE.example: Try to look at the situation from a different perspective.
PERSPECTIVE.exampleZh: 試著從不同的觀點來看待這個情況。

senses.meaning: 觀點、視角

examples.en: We need to get a fresh perspective on this issue.
examples.zh: 我們需要用全新的觀點來看待這個問題。

examples.en: From a financial perspective, the project is too risky.
examples.zh: 從財務的觀點來看，這個專案風險太大了。

AUTHORIZE.example: The director said he had already authorized the payment.
AUTHORIZE.exampleZh: 主管說他已經批准了這筆付款。

senses.meaning: 授權；批准

examples.en: The director said he had already authorized the payment.
examples.zh: 主管說他已經批准了這筆付款。

examples.en: If they authorized the project, we could begin immediately.
examples.zh: 如果他們批准這個專案，我們就可以馬上開始。

OVERLOOK.example: We shouldn't overlook these minor details.
OVERLOOK.exampleZh: 我們不應該忽略這些小細節。

senses.meaning: 忽略

examples.en: We shouldn't overlook these minor details.
examples.zh: 我們不應該忽略這些小細節。

examples.en: It's easy to overlook a spelling mistake in your own work.
examples.zh: 在自己的作品中很容易忽略拼字錯誤。

VIP.word: vip 貴賓室的使用權限一定是因系統錯誤而被撤銷了。
VIP.meaning: 因系統錯誤而被撤銷了
VIP.example: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
VIP.exampleZh: 英文原句：The VIP lounge access must have been revoked due to a system error. (VIP 貴賓室的使用權限一定是因系統錯誤而被撤銷了

HAVE BEEN ANALYZING.meaning: 題目強調一段時間內持續進行的動作
HAVE BEEN ANALYZING.example: The financial advisors have been analyzing the recent market trends to identify new investment opportunities for their clients.
HAVE BEEN ANALYZING.exampleZh: 題目強調一段時間內持續進行的動作，且與現在有關

MUST HAVE LEAKED.meaning: 對於過去發生的事情作非常有把握的推測
MUST HAVE LEAKED.example: The stock price crashed unexpectedly this morning. The CEO must have leaked some terrible news to the major shareholders.
MUST HAVE LEAKED.exampleZh: 對於過去發生的事情作非常有把握的推測，使用 must have + 過去分詞 (must have leaked)。

TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED.meaning: 被廣泛認為已經由...引發
TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED.example: The sudden drop in cryptocurrency values is widely believed to have been triggered by the new regulatory policies announced yesterday.
TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED.exampleZh: 「被廣泛認為已經由...引發」，is believed 後接不定詞，因為動作發生在過去，用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been triggered)

PORTFOLIOS.example: Investors are advised to diversify their portfolios to reduce the risks associated with volatile markets.

LIQUIDATE.example: The company decided to liquidate its assets in the overseas branch in order to pay off the accumulating debt.
LIQUIDATE.exampleZh: liquidate 意為「變賣（資產）、清算」。

HAVE BEEN MONITORING.example: Environmental inspectors have been monitoring the water quality of the river since the chemical spill occurred.
HAVE BEEN MONITORING.exampleZh: 自化學外洩發生以來，調查員「一直在監測」水質，故用現在完成進行式

TO HAVE MADE.example: The endangered species is reported to have made a remarkable recovery due to the new conservation laws.
TO HAVE MADE.exampleZh: 據報導，該物種已經復育成功

MUST HAVE HALTED.meaning: 在檢查期間暫停了運作
MUST HAVE HALTED.example: The air pollution levels dropped significantly overnight. The factories must have halted their operations during the inspection.
MUST HAVE HALTED.exampleZh: 針對過去狀況的肯定推測：「工廠一定是在檢查期間暫停了運作」，用 must have + V-en。

MANDATE.example: The board gave him a clear mandate.
MANDATE.exampleZh: 董事會給了他明確的授權。

DEPLETE.example: If we continue to deplete our natural resources at this alarming rate, future generations will face severe shortages.
DEPLETE.exampleZh: deplete 意為「耗盡、大量減少」。

HAS BEEN INVESTIGATING.example: The engineering team has been investigating the faulty braking mechanism since the first customer reported the issue.
HAS BEEN INVESTIGATING.exampleZh: 自第一位顧客回報問題以來，團隊「一直在調查」，使用現在完成進行式

TO BE REMOVED.example: The contaminated food products are required to be removed from all supermarket shelves immediately to prevent further illness.
TO BE REMOVED.exampleZh: 產品「被要求從架上移除」，因此 require 後方接被動的不定詞 to be removed

HAZARDOUS.example: Prolonged exposure to these chemical fumes is highly hazardous to human health and can cause respiratory failure.
HAZARDOUS.exampleZh: hazardous 意為「危險的、有害的」。

TO HAVE BEEN SUSCEPTIBLE.meaning: 過去一直易受過熱影響
TO HAVE BEEN SUSCEPTIBLE.example:
A: Is it true that the new smartphones are catching fire?
B: Yes, the battery units are known to have been susceptible to overheating under extreme pressure.
TO HAVE BEEN SUSCEPTIBLE.exampleZh: 電池被認為「過去一直易受過熱影響」，用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been susceptible)

DISMANTLE.example: Because of the severe safety risk, the manufacturer decided to completely dismantle the production line and rebuild it.

SUDDEN DIZZINESS.example: Recall Notice: We have been receiving reports of a critical software glitch in the Model X pacemakers. The device is confirmed to have occasionally skipped beats during high-intensity exercise. Patients must have experienced sudden dizziness as a result. A free firmware update will be provided at all clinics. Q: What symptom did the glitch likely cause for patients?
SUDDEN DIZZINESS.exampleZh: 文中提到「Patients must have experienced sudden dizziness...」，因此最可能造成的症狀是突發性頭暈 (dizziness)。

SUBSTANDARD.example: Safety Warning: The electrical wiring in the recent batch of space heaters is considered to be substandard. Several units have already melted during use. The quality assurance team must have bypassed the final thermal stress test. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
SUBSTANDARD.exampleZh: substandard 意指「不合標準的、劣質的」。

HAVE BEEN EXAMINING.example: Psychologists have been examining the impact of social media on adolescent self-esteem for several years now.
HAVE BEEN EXAMINING.exampleZh: 「這幾年來一直在研究」，持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式

TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED.meaning: 是過去由童年創傷所引起的
TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED.example: The unusual behavioral pattern is hypothesized to have been caused by severe childhood trauma.
TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED.exampleZh: 這種行為模式被假設「是過去由童年創傷所引起的」，使用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been caused)

MUST NOT HAVE EXPLAINED.example: The participants reacted identically to the placebo. The researchers must not have explained the instructions clearly enough.
MUST NOT HAVE EXPLAINED.exampleZh: 對過去事實的否定推測：「研究人員一定沒有把指示解釋清楚」，用 must not have + V-en。

DEVIATES.example:
A: What did the latest neurological study reveal?
B: It suggested that our perception of time deviates drastically when we are exposed to high-adrenaline situations.

SUSCEPTIBLE.example: Children are highly susceptible to external influences, which is why positive reinforcement is crucial during early development.
SUSCEPTIBLE.exampleZh: susceptible to 意為「易受...影響的」。

STIMULUS.example: Psychology Journal: The subjects have been performing poorly on the memory tasks since the background noise was introduced. The auditory stimulus is proven to have disrupted their concentration. The scientists must have underestimated the brain's sensitivity to random sounds. Q: Which word fits the blank best?

A FEELING OF CONFUSION.example: Research Summary: We have been observing the participants' reactions to visual illusions. The visual cortex is understood to have processed the conflicting images at different speeds. The delay in processing must have manifested as a feeling of confusion in the subjects. Q: What was the physical result of the processing delay?
A FEELING OF CONFUSION.exampleZh: 文中指出「The delay in processing must have manifested as a feeling of confusion」，故結果為困惑感。

HAS BEEN WORKING.example: The public relations team has been working tirelessly to salvage the brand's reputation since the scandal broke out.
HAS BEEN WORKING.exampleZh: 自醜聞爆發以來，公關團隊「一直持續在努力」挽救聲譽，用現在完成進行式

MUST HAVE SABOTAGED.meaning: 對過去事件的肯定推測
MUST HAVE SABOTAGED.example: The confidential emails were leaked to the press. A high-ranking executive must have sabotaged the company's internal server.
MUST HAVE SABOTAGED.exampleZh: 對過去事件的肯定推測：「某個高層主管一定暗中破壞/駭入了內部伺服器」，用 must have V-en。

TO HAVE EMBEZZLED.example: The former CEO is widely known to have embezzled company funds for personal luxury expenses over the last five years.
TO HAVE EMBEZZLED.exampleZh: 前執行長被廣泛認為「過去曾經盜用公款」

SCRUTINY.meaning: 法官對侵害權利法案之審查
SCRUTINY.example: Regulations touching upon core political rights are subjected to exacting judicial scrutiny.
SCRUTINY.exampleZh: 任何膽敢將黑手伸向公民核心政治權利的行政規章，都必將在各級法庭面臨最嚴酷無情的司法審查。

senses.meaning: 仔細且帶有檢驗目的的審視

examples.en: The recommendation did not withstand scrutiny.
examples.zh: 這項建議經不起仔細檢驗。

examples.en: The figures deserve closer scrutiny before publication.
examples.zh: 數據在發表前值得更仔細審視。

senses.meaning: 對政策文件或財務進行嚴密審查與仔細檢驗

examples.en: Every clause in the diplomatic pact was subjected to multilateral scrutiny.
examples.zh: 外交條約中的每一項條款都接受了多邊的嚴密審查。

senses.meaning: 嚴密的審查與鑑識分析

examples.en: Regulatory scrutiny prevented predatory mergers across essential utilities.
examples.zh: 嚴格的監管審查阻止了公用事業領域的掠奪性併購。

senses.meaning: 法院對涉嫌侵害人權的法案進行的極其細緻深入的司法審查

examples.en: Courts apply intermediate scrutiny to statutes that differentiate on the basis of sex.
examples.zh: 在審查涉及基於性別劃分與差別待遇的爭議法案時，法官們將依法啟動嚴謹的中度司法審查檢驗標準。

senses.meaning: 法官對侵害權利法案之審查

examples.en: Regulations touching upon core political rights are subjected to exacting judicial scrutiny.
examples.zh: 任何膽敢將黑手伸向公民核心政治權利的行政規章，都必將在各級法庭面臨最嚴酷無情的司法審查。

BACKLASH.example: The severe public backlash forced the board of directors to reconsider their controversial restructuring plan.
BACKLASH.exampleZh: backlash 意為「強烈反彈、反對」。

THE PATIENT IS BEING OBSERVED CLOSELY.word: the patient is being observed closely
THE PATIENT IS BEING OBSERVED CLOSELY.meaning: 病人正在受到密切觀察

HAS BEEN ASSESSING.meaning: 動作從過去持續到現在

HAS BEEN ASSESSING.exampleZh: 本題測驗現在完成進行式

TO HAVE BEEN REVIEWED.example: The anonymous survey results are reported to have been reviewed by the executive board behind closed doors yesterday.
TO HAVE BEEN REVIEWED.exampleZh: 本題測驗複雜被動語態

MUST HAVE IGNORED.example: Only half of the staff completed the questionnaire; the others must have ignored the due date notification.
MUST HAVE IGNORED.exampleZh: 本題測驗對過去事實的肯定推測。

HAS BEEN RENOVATING.meaning: 動作從過去兩週一直持續到現在還在進行中
HAS BEEN RENOVATING.example:
A: Why is the staff lounge closed?
B: The management has been renovating it for the past two weeks to create a better rest area.
HAS BEEN RENOVATING.exampleZh: 對話中提到 for the past two weeks，表示動作從過去兩週一直持續到現在還在進行中，需使用現在完成進行式

MUST HAVE ROUTED.example: You didn't receive the wellness questionnaire? The automated mail server must have routed it to your spam folder by mistake.
MUST HAVE ROUTED.exampleZh: 針對過去發生的情況（沒收到信）做出強烈推斷，「一定是分類到垃圾信件匣了」，須用 must have + V-p.p.。

EXCESSIVE WORKING HOURS.example:
HR Notice: We have been gathering input from all departments regarding workplace stress. The long hours are suspected to have caused extreme burnout among the junior staff. Supervisors must have failed to recognize the early signs of exhaustion.
Q: What is identified as the root of the problem?
EXCESSIVE WORKING HOURS.exampleZh: 短文中提到「The long hours are suspected to have caused extreme burnout」，可推知問題的根源是工時過長 (Excessive working hours)。

IT WILL TAKE PLACE NEARBY.meaning: 今年的員工旅遊會在本地舉辦
IT WILL TAKE PLACE NEARBY.example:
【短文】Memo: The annual retreat has been undergoing major changes. The event is expected to be hosted locally this year to cut costs. The planning committee must have realized that international travel is no longer viable for our budget.
Q: What is true about the annual retreat?
IT WILL TAKE PLACE NEARBY.exampleZh: 短文中提到「hosted locally this year to cut costs」，表示今年的員工旅遊會在本地舉辦，因此地點會在附近 (nearby)

HAVE BEEN OBSERVING.meaning: 動作持續了一段時間並延續至今
HAVE BEEN OBSERVING.example: City planners have been observing the traffic congestion at the main intersection for several months to find a solution.
HAVE BEEN OBSERVING.exampleZh: for several months 表示動作持續了一段時間並延續至今，故選擇現在完成進行式

TO BE ENFORCED.example: The controversial toll tax is scheduled to be enforced by the municipal council next spring.
TO BE ENFORCED.exampleZh: 稅收 (toll tax) 是被執行的，因此在 is scheduled 之後要接被動不定詞 to be + V-p.p.

HAS BEEN FOCUSING.example:
A: Have they fixed the pothole on 5th Avenue?
B: No, the road crew has been focusing on the highway expansion instead.
HAS BEEN FOCUSING.exampleZh: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調工程人員「這陣子一直專注於」高速公路擴建，用現在完成進行式最符合情境

TO HAVE SHORTENED.example: The expanded bicycle lanes are proven to have shortened commuting times for residents in the suburbs over the last year.
TO HAVE SHORTENED.exampleZh: over the last year 指向過去的成果，are proven 後方需搭配完成式不定詞 to have shortened 來表示已經發生的縮短效果

HAVE BEEN PATROLLING.example: Health inspectors have been patrolling local restaurants continuously to ensure proper sanitation standards are met.
HAVE BEEN PATROLLING.exampleZh: continuously 暗示動作從過去一直持續到現在，因此選現在完成進行式最能表達「持續不斷巡查」的語意

TO BE WITHDRAWN.example: The contaminated batch of frozen vegetables is ordered to be withdrawn from all retail stores nationwide immediately.
TO BE WITHDRAWN.exampleZh: 蔬菜是「被撤下」，在 is ordered 之後應接被動的不定詞 to be withdrawn

MUST HAVE ALLOWED.example: Several consumers reported food poisoning; the restaurant must have allowed cross-contamination in the kitchen yesterday.
MUST HAVE ALLOWED.exampleZh: 句末有 yesterday，推論昨天廚房裡「一定允許/發生了」交叉污染，用 must have + V-p.p.。

HAS BEEN EXECUTING.meaning: 動作從早上持續到說話的當下
HAS BEEN EXECUTING.example:
A: Why is the dairy aisle empty?
B: The supermarket chain has been executing a massive recall on all milk products since this morning.
HAS BEEN EXECUTING.exampleZh: since this morning 表示動作從早上持續到說話的當下，需用現在完成進行式

THROUGH POLLUTED FOOD SOURCES.example:
News Report: The agricultural department has been tracking a new strain of bacteria in poultry farms. The infection is believed to have spread through contaminated feed. Farm owners must have skipped the mandatory sterilization procedures during the busy holiday season.
Q: How did the bacteria likely spread?
THROUGH POLLUTED FOOD SOURCES.exampleZh: 短文中提到「spread through contaminated feed (受到污染的飼料)」，因此與 polluted food sources 意思相符。

BREAKABLE PACKAGING.example:
Press Release: The beverage company has been recalling thousands of glass bottles. A manufacturing flaw is confirmed to have caused the glass to shatter easily. Consumers must have experienced injuries while opening the caps.
Q: What hazard is associated with the bottles?
BREAKABLE PACKAGING.exampleZh: 短文中提到「caused the glass to shatter easily (導致玻璃容易碎裂)」，因此危險在於易碎的包裝 (Breakable packaging)。

HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZING.meaning: 並強調一直進行到現在的狀態
HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZING.example: Ethicists have been scrutinizing the potential biases in machine learning algorithms for years without finding a perfect solution.
HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZING.exampleZh: for years 點出持續多年的動作，並強調一直進行到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成進行式

TO HAVE TRIGGERED.example: The autonomous driving software is alleged to have triggered several traffic accidents due to sensor failure last month.
TO HAVE TRIGGERED.exampleZh: 軟體被宣稱在「上個月」引發了事故

MUST HAVE LACKED.meaning: 當時的訓練資料一定缺乏多樣性
MUST HAVE LACKED.example: The facial recognition system misidentified the suspect; its training data must have lacked diversity.
MUST HAVE LACKED.exampleZh: 系統誤認了嫌犯（過去式），所以推測「當時的訓練資料一定缺乏多樣性」，選 must have + V-p.p.。

HAVE BEEN WARNING.example:
A: Is the new AI tool replacing human writers?
B: Critics have been warning about that possibility, but creativity remains uniquely human.
HAVE BEEN WARNING.exampleZh: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調評論家「近期以來一直在警告」這件事，故用現在完成進行式最自然

TO HAVE COMPELLED.example: The new privacy legislation is widely acknowledged to have compelled tech companies to rewrite their data collection policies.
TO HAVE COMPELLED.exampleZh: 法規被廣泛承認「已經迫使」科技公司重寫政策

MUST HAVE OMITTED.example: The chatbot generated highly offensive remarks. The developers must have omitted adequate content filters before the official launch.
MUST HAVE OMITTED.exampleZh: 因為機器人已經產生了冒犯言論，推斷開發者在發布前「一定遺漏了」過濾器。

HAS BEEN SPONSORING.meaning: 出動作從六月持續至今

HAS BEEN SPONSORING.exampleZh: since June 明確指出動作從六月持續至今，故選現在完成進行式 has been sponsoring

TO HAVE TARNISHED.example: The controversial advertisement is considered to have tarnished the brand's reputation among younger consumers.
TO HAVE TARNISHED.exampleZh: 這則廣告被認為「已經玷污了」品牌聲譽，破壞的動作已經發生，因此用 to have tarnished

HAS BEEN REVAMPING.example:
A: Why did they change the logo again?

HAS BEEN REVAMPING.exampleZh: 對話表達設計團隊「一直以來都在進行」視覺形象的改造，用現在完成進行式最符合語氣

TO HAVE GENERATED.example: The viral marketing stunt is estimated to have generated over ten million impressions within the first 24 hours of its release.
TO HAVE GENERATED.exampleZh: 這個行銷噱頭被估計「已經產生了」超過一千萬次曝光，動作已完成，故搭配 to have generated

SPONSORING GAMERS.example:

SPONSORING GAMERS.exampleZh: 短文中提及「partnership with e-sports athletes (與電競選手合作)」，即指贊助遊戲玩家 (Sponsoring gamers)。

senses.meaning: 政府透過稅收或企業營運獲得之總收入

examples.en: Tax revenue declined precipitously during the industrial downturn.

CLIENT.example: We have a meeting with a new client.

AGREEMENT.exampleZh: 經過長時間的討論，他們終於達成了協議。

senses.meaning: 同意；協議

examples.en: Please sign the agreement before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五之前簽署協議。

examples.en: I am in agreement with your proposal.

CANDIDATE.example: She is the best candidate for the job.

POSITION.example: She applied for the sales position.

HAVE BEEN ASSESSING.meaning: 從過去一直持續到現在的動作
HAVE BEEN ASSESSING.example: The board of directors have been assessing potential mergers since the new fiscal year began.
HAVE BEEN ASSESSING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 since 加上過去時間點，表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，且強調持續性，應使用現在完成進行式 (have been V-ing)

TO BE DRIVEN.example: The unprecedented revenue growth is projected to be driven by a new digital infrastructure.
TO BE DRIVEN.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：project (預計) 後方接不定詞 to V，而營收成長是「被」數位基礎設施所驅動，因此需要用不定詞的被動語態 to be p.p.

MUST HAVE DISMISSED.example: We secured the dominant market share. Our competitors must have dismissed our aggressive expansion plan.
MUST HAVE DISMISSED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：前句提到「我們取得了主導市佔率（已發生的事實）」，後句推測對手過去一定做錯了什麼決定，表示對過去事實的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。

TO BE DISTRIBUTED.example:
A: Did the shareholders approve the dividend payout?
B: Yes, a generous dividend is confirmed to be distributed to all investors next month.
TO BE DISTRIBUTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：confirm 後方如接動作，常見為 is confirmed to V (被確認將會...)

DIVERSIFICATION.example:
Shareholder Letter: We have been expanding our footprint in emerging markets. This strategic diversification is anticipated to yield substantial returns by 2028. Management must have foreseen the stagnation in domestic sales.
Q: Which word fits the blank best?
DIVERSIFICATION.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文提到公司一直在新興市場擴張版圖，這種「多元化/分散投資 (diversification)」預計將帶來回報。

THE SUDDEN RISE IN RAW MATERIAL PRICES.word: the sudden rise in raw material prices
THE SUDDEN RISE IN RAW MATERIAL PRICES.meaning: 原物料價格突然飆升一定讓採購團隊措手不及
THE SUDDEN RISE IN RAW MATERIAL PRICES.example:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: Our operational costs are reported to have spiked last quarter. The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. We have been restructuring the supplier contracts to mitigate this issue.

THE SUDDEN RISE IN RAW MATERIAL PRICES.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. (原物料價格突然飆升一定讓採購團隊措手不及)」，這正是營運成本飆升 (spiked) 的主因

CHANNEL.example: My father watched the evening sports channel yesterday after dinner.
